programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E21 "Gumballův nepřítel Rob si přeje se ho jednou provždy zbavit, a tak divákům navrhuje celou řadu pořadů s jinými hlavními postavami, než je Gumball. Bohužel pro Roba je jeden horší než druhý…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E01 "Je první den nového školního roku a táta má za úkol dopravit děti včas do školy. Jenže zaspal a teď nemůže Gumballa, Darwina ani Anais nikde najít. Vydá se proto zpět po vlastních stopách, aby zjistil, co předchozího dne dělal a kde by mohli být."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E02 "Gumballa a Darwina už nebaví věčně poslouchat Mollyiny dlouhé a únavné vtipy, a tak se rozhodnout naučit ji vyprávět je zábavnějším způsobem. Když se jim to nepovede, napadne je, že musejí Molly zprostředkovat příběh, který bude stát za vyprávění."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E03 "Gumball a Darwin podrobí Joshe, nového kamaráda Anais, sérii zkoušek, aby zjistili, jestli je pro jejich sestru dost dobrý. Jenomže extrémní přístup obou chlapců Joshe vyděsí, a tak si začne říkat, jestli mu Anais za všechny ty zkoušky stojí. A tak musí Gumball a Darwin Joshe přesvědčit, že má dát Anais ještě jednu šanci."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E04 "Gumball a Darwin jsou přesvědčení, že se daného dne nic zajímavého nestane. Vydají se proto do Elmoru, aby natrefili na nějaké dobrodružství, čím dál víc je ale jasné, že práve jim se vzrušující zážitky přímo vyhýbají."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E05 "Když Gumball s Darwinem omylem najdou na Alanově flashdisku zlověstný tajný manifest, rozhodnou se, že musejí jeho plán na ovládnutí světa překazit. Poté, co se představa Alanova nového světového řádu vymkne kontrole, uchýlí se Gumball s Darwinem k zoufalým krokům."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E06 "Typická stresující rodinná večeře u Wattersonových dotlačí mámu až na pokraj duševních sil, a tak Nicole začne vzpomínat, jak se seznámila s Richardem. Mohl být její život lepší, kdyby se tehdy vůbec nepustila do hovoru se svým budoucím manželem, a místo toho se vydala jinou cestou?"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E07 "Gumball se dozví, že Wattersonovi už celé roky kradou wi-fi pana Robinsona. Když jednou wi-fi přestane fungovat, pokusí se žít bez ní. Ale život bez internetu se ukáže jako příliš těžký. Gumball s Darwinem se proto rozhodnou, že se prohackují kyberprostorem a zjistí Robinsonovo heslo."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E19 "Když Darwin požádá Gumballa, aby ho naučil jezdit na skateboardu, Gumball se postará o to, aby se vyznal ve všech oblastech životního stylu skateboardingu - od správného oblečení přes správné výrazy až po výběr správného prkna. Jenže když se má Darwin nakonec rozjet, uvědomí si, že v jedné podstatné oblasti skateboardingu ho Gumball nenaučil nic..."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E13 "Když Darwin obědvá s Idahem, ze solidarity vůči svému bramborovému kamarádovi se rozhodne přestat jíst brambory. Jenže zbavit se posedlosti oblíbeným jídlem je pro něj nepředstavitelně obtížné, a tak se mu Gumball snaží pomoct udržet choutky na uzdě."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E26 "Gumball se odmítá smířit s tím, že jako jediný ze školy nemá zvláštní schopnosti. Přemluví paní Jötunheim, Hectorovu mámu, aby ho přijala za svého učně, ale brzy se ukáže, že nechat Gumballa kouzlit bez dozoru je velká chyba."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E18 "Když Gumball dostane prokletou herní konzoli, Elmore se stane součástí světa fantasy RPG hry. Gumball, Darwin a Anais si musejí probít cestu městem a odhalit tajemství nové virtuální reality. Musejí se nalevelovat, aby vůbec měli šanci proti závěrečnému bossovi."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E14 "Rodina jede navštívit Richardova otce. Vzhledem k jeho životnímu stylu a jeho dlouhé absenci v Richardově životě dojdou k závěru, že Frankie seděl v base. Když Frankie pak dorazí k nim, rozhodnou se udělat mu pohodlí tak, že mu zajistí nepohodlí a promění svůj dům ve věznici."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E12 "Gumball s Darwinem jsou zmatení, když potkají Kikiho a Quacka, sourozence napodobující vše, co udělají a řeknou. Zjistí, že jejich rodina vydělává na tom, že kopíruje rodinu Wattersonových! Poté, co se je marně snaží navést k tomu, aby si našli vlastní identity, Wattersonovým dojde, že musejí pro daný problém najít trvalejší řešení."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E20 "Když Gumball s Darwinem zjistí, že děda Louie nemá žádné přátele na Elmore Plus, z lítosti mu vytvoří Muriel. Jenže když se babička Jojo dozví, že Louie tráví čas na internetu s jinou "ženou", neexistence Muriel jí nezabrání v tom, aby ji zničila."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E21 "Děti zjistí, že po Richardovi se už od střední školy vozí jeden a tentýž člověk."

Při čtení Anaisina deníčku zjistí, že její vztah s novou kamarádkou se zdá poněkud jednostranný. Jodie snědla Anaisin oběd, shrábla zásluhy za její práci a přinutila ji nést jí batoh. Gumball si o ní myslí, že je parazit, a chce dokázat, že vymyla Anais mozek. Ale když obě dívky splynou do jednoho organismu, není snadné poznat, kdo že je parazit a kdo hostitel…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E26 "Obyvatelé města Elmore pátrají po smyslu lásky. Když Bobert zjistí, že ho napadl virus s názvem miluji_tě.exe, požádá Gumballa s Darwinem, aby mu vysvětlili význam slova "láska". Ti se mu ho pokusí vysvětlit pomocí písně, ale tím mu pochopení vůbec neusnadní. A tak poprosí ostatní obyvatele města Elmore, aby se podělili o vlastní pohled na to, co pro ně znamená láska."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E39 "Gumball, Darwin a Carrie se spřáhnou a přesvědčí své spolužáky, že ve škole straší. Během halloweenské prezentace děti Gumballově historce o Gargarothovi Požírači zprvu nevěří; pak ale Carrie nafinguje, že ve třídě příšerně straší. Trojice školu přesvědčí, aby si je najala na vyhánění duchů, a nechávají si zaplatit halloweenskými sladkostmi. Jenže když se ukáže, že Gargaroth skutečně existuje, všichni předpokládají, že Gumball město zachrání."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E27 "Gumball jde stejným směrem jako Hotdog a s každým dalším krokem je jim to čím dál tím trapnější. Gumball je tak zabraný do zpívání o kečupu, že vrazí do Hotdoga. Tuhle trapnou chvilku se jim sice povede překonat, ale vzápětí zjistí, že se ubírají stejným směrem. Jejich společná cesta je čím dál tím trapnější, až se je nakonec pokusí zatknout popletený hlídač obchodu a konečně jim umožní, aby se rozešli každý za svým…"

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Charlotte, Elvis and Jack
programme.desc: Actress Eileen Davidson's Wheaten terrier puppy Charlotte, plays too rough with her son. Two other dogs react to household triggers, the garbage disposal and shiny floors.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Princess Cujo, Prada, and Bearz
programme.desc: Los Angeles Lakers executive Jeanie Buss asks Cesar to take the "Cujo" out of Princess. Prada, a pampered Pomeranian throws vicious temper tantrums, and Bearz, a Rottweiler attacks shopping carts.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Cesar's Worst Bite
programme.desc: Holly, a Labrador puppy, displays severe food aggression; a women's shelter will take a needy woman and her pit bull, Tucker, but Cesar must help the dog become less protective first.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Rana & Ruby
programme.desc: Scared of everything, Ruby the Vischla deals with her neuroses by biting. At the same time, Rana barks every time bread pops in the toaster, or when the microwave goes off, or when the phone rings.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Viper and Diesel
programme.desc: Viper, a trained K9 detection dog is unable to enter a prison because of his fear of strangers. Family dog, Diesel, took a turn for the worse when his canine companion, Chopper, passed away.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Tyson, Moose, and Rylie & Tucker
programme.desc: Model Kim Strother is in desperate need of rescuing. Her Yorkshire Terrier Moose is a menace to society. when they go for walks, barking and biting at passersby and their dogs.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Major Jones, Josie, and Scrappy
programme.desc: Catchup with the hurricane Katrina rescue dogs. Is a reunion with their owners in store for any of them? A German Shephard learns to walk on a leash. A lab won’t walk on hardwood floors.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: The Language of Scrout
programme.desc: A Doberman Mix has taken control of his family home; an animal communicator calls for back-up with her Doberman Pinscher; and a comedienne enlists Cesar's help for her two temperamental rescue dogs.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: The Dog Whisperer: Cesar Down Under
programme.sub-title: The Dog Whisperer: Cesar Down Under
programme.desc: Cesar’s adventures in the UK continue with unstable dogs and the people who love them. You’ll meet a dog walker, littermates who no longer get along, and a couple who can’t get their dog in the car.

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Miles and Maxie & Booker
programme.desc: Former Guns N’ Roses drummer, Matt Sorum need help controlling his ten month old French bulldog Miles’ aggression. And then, can Cesar clear the name of a dog who killed its sibling?

programme.title: The Dog Whisperer: Mufasa and Tucker

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown
programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: Merry Good Enough
programme.desc: Lucy Raulie has always had a complicated relationship with her family, but when her mother disappears on Christmas Eve, the dysfunctional family hit a new all-time low. Aided by her reluctant siblings in an attempt to bring the family back together, the Raulie kids may get more than they bargained for when their eccentric father, George, also shows up to "help" in the search for their wayward mom. A razor-sharp and delightfully heartwarming festive comedy, packed with classic Christmas songs and a stand-out ensemble cast, including Joel Murray (Mad Men), Sawyer Spielberg (Masters of the Air), Susan Gallagher (Cobra Kai), Neil Casey (Ghostbusters, Avenue 5), Comfort Clinton (Billions, FBI), Sophie von Haselberg (Give Me Pity, Pose) and Raye Spielberg.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend (James Ransone) hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra (Mya Taylor), embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumour. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: Santa Stole Our Dog
programme.desc: A magical holiday adventure featuring original Christmas songs by Dolly Parton, and starring Golden Globe winner, Ed Asner (Elf, Up). The Whitehaven family embark on a whirlwind adventure to the North Pole when their beloved dog, Rusty, goes missing on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Christmas at the Ranch
programme.desc: When Haley Hollis returns to her family ranch, she wasn't banking on spending so much time with with ranch hand Kate - or falling for her.

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas 2: Great Puppy Rescue
programme.desc: In this heartwarming sequel to the holiday classic, Emma (Danielle Chuchran) rallies her friends new and old to save a beloved puppy orphanage by putting on a musical holiday extravaganza.

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: A Christmas Kiss
programme.desc: A romantic drama in the backdrop of Christmas time in Wisconsin, revolving around two college sweethearts who rekindle their love during the holiday season

programme.title: The Claus Family
programme.desc: After discovering his grandfather is Santa Claus, Jules has to help him deliver his presents all around the world. But Jules' hatred for Christmas might make that more difficult than Santa thought.

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown
programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: The Nights Before Christmas
programme.desc: In this Christmas set horror, a pair of crazed killers have written a very special 'naughty' list of targets. You better watch out, as now they've checked it twice, all sorts of festive hell is about to break loose! When a series of murders in the run up to Christmas are found to be linked, FBI Special Agent Natalie Parker is tasked with tracking a pair of psychotic serial killers. But she soon discovers the couple are not only crazy, having met in and escaped from an asylum for the criminally insane, but have based their personas on Santa and Mrs Claus. As Christmas approaches, they slaughter their way through their special naughty list, playing a cat and mouse game with the FBI and leaving a trail of gruesome bloody bodies in their wake.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, but after five years of marriage, a huge fight at Thanksgiving leads them to divorce, set to be finalised on Christmas day. As they try to move on with their lives, will the festive spirit pull them back together? Starring Erica Ash (Scary Movie 5, Survivor's Remorse) and Eva Marcille (The Young and the Restless).

programme.title: The Three Dogateers Save Christmas
programme.desc: When a couple of burglars make off with their family's presents and decorations, the Three Dogateers set off on a journey to sniff out the bad guys and save Christmas!

programme.title: Benji's Very Own Christmas Story
programme.desc: On a surprise visit to meet Kris Kringle, Benji and his friends are shocked to discover that he plans to take the night off on Christmas Eve!

programme.title: Feather Christmas
programme.desc: For single dad, and veterinarian, Martin, Christmas is all about upholding regular family traditions to keep the memory of his late wife alive. But when an ailing pet chicken arrives at his home-run animal sanctuary, the family's festive plans, and entire world, are turned upside down, as new love blossoms and spreads its wings!

programme.title: Christmas Couple's Retreat
programme.desc: Three couples attend a retreat to strengthen their respective relationships under the guidance of a famed therapist. But as the holiday season unfolds, unexpected challenges arise when the therapist must confront some feelings of her own, and sparks fly when one couple's son unexpectedly falls for the charming retreat manager. Will this festive getaway reignite these couples' love, or will it lead them down an entirely new path?

programme.title: Colorado Christmas
programme.desc: Single mum Melody Miller has left her dream job of teaching music to work as a carer, so that she can better provide for her young daughter. When one of her clients falls ill, his son rushes home, who to Melody's surprise turns out to be none other than country music superstar, Johnny Colorado! As the unlikely pair grow closer, it looks like it could be the start of the perfect Christmas romance, until an old flame of Johnny's arrives at the family ranch....

programme.title: On Angel Wings
programme.desc: One starry night, a shepherd boy is taken on a secret, magical night-flight to witness a Christmas miracle. Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night; he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: Occupation: Rainfall
programme.desc: From the VFX team behind The Last Jedi, this sci-fi action epic stars Harry Potter's Jason Isaacs, The Mandalorian's Temuera Morrison and The Hangover's Ken Jeong. After an intergalactic invasion of Earth, the resistance uncover a plot that could see a decisive end to the war. But with the alien invaders hell-bent on making Earth their home, the race is on to save the planet.

programme.title: Candy Corn
programme.desc: A traveling carnival is in town for the weekend and local outcast, Jacob Atkins, has been hired as one of the freaks in the events main attraction. Meanwhile, a group of local bullies are planning their annual public hazing of Jacob, but this year things go too far

programme.title: Bloodthirsty
programme.desc: Frightfest Presents. Ambition can be killer. When an offer to work with one of the greatest music producers of all time comes along, singer Grey cant refuse but her new mentor isnt all that he seems to be. Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: Hell Is Where The Home Is
programme.desc: Two couples renting a luxury home in the desert are thrust into chaos when a mysterious woman arrives, claiming car trouble and refusing to leave.

programme.title: Death Trench
programme.desc: In the final days of WWI a shell-shocked tunneller leads an Allied team into a hidden German base... one hundred feet below the trenches. The Germans have lost control of a highly contagious biological weapon that turns its victims into deranged killers. The Allies find themselves trapped underground with hordes of the infected, a rapidly spreading disease and a team of German Stormtroopers dispatched to clean up the mess

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: Gripping, exhilarating and a whole-heartedly rich emotional rollercoaster. Fourteen-year-old urban teenager David journeys to the remote mountains of Montana to hunt big game with his estranged father. They struggle to see eye to eye and develop a bond, until a brutal encounter in the heart of the wilderness changes everything for father and son forcing them to strive to survive together.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: Heart-warming and hilarious, this family tale stars Academy Award nominee Clive Owen (Children of Men) and Maria Bello (A History of Violence). Walt, a down-on-his luck carpenter, is tasked with entertaining his eight-year-old son Anthony. But when Walt's prized toolbox is stolen, a quiet father-and-son weekend turns into an adventure of a lifetime. This sincere story of fatherhood is a must see!

programme.title: Kids in Love
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of a bohemian London, Kids in Love offers a new take on the traditional coming of age story. Drifting through his gap year Jack, (Will Poulter: Detroit) has always suspected there was more to life than this. However, a chance encounter with the beautiful Evelyn and her friends, including free spirited Viola (Cara Delevingne), swerves his life radically off course.

programme.title: Mythica: The Iron Crown
programme.desc: Good and evil battle it out in the fourth gripping adventure from the fantastical franchise. When daring young wizard Marek steals the final piece of the all-powerful Darkspore she embarks on a desperate quest to deliver the cursed artefact to the gods. But is caught in a death race between a ruthless team of elite mercenaries and a trinity of demons.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: A heart-breaking family drama starring Claire Danes, Jim Parsons and Octavia Spencer. Parents, Alex and Greg are approaching an important crossroads - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake, a precocious four-year-old who happens to prefer Disney princesses to G.I. Joe. However, as Jake's behaviour becomes increasingly erratic and perplexing, a rift begins to emerge between them.

programme.title: Arthur and Merlin
programme.desc: A spectacular fantasy-epic, recounting the legendary adventures of two iconic characters. In Dark Ages Britain, a time of myth and magic, a Saxon force from the East attacks the Celtic people. However, hope is not lost when Arthur, a banished warrior, and Merlin, a hermit wizard, embark on a heroic quest to save their people. A mystic and mythical tale of courage and valour.

programme.title: 15 Minutes Of War
programme.desc: A group of Somalian rebels hijack a school bus carrying twenty-one French children and an American teacher and drive it to no-mans-land, on the Somali border. French captain Andr Gerval is called to lead a team of elite snipers to secretly prepare an emergency rescue. With time running out, Gerval and his team take sole responsibility of carrying out a simultaneous five-men sniper attack to get the children and their teacher out safely.

programme.title: 12 Hour Shift
programme.desc: One night, do no harm for one junkie nurse thats not an oath shes willing to keep. Mandy (Angela Bettis - May) finds herself beholden to a gang of organ-traffickers (David Arquette - The Scream Franchise, Mick Foley - WWE) and when a kidney goes missing she's going to do whatever it takes. Throw in to the mix a strung out cousin with bad judgement and the bodies begin to pile up.

programme.title: Casual Encounters
programme.desc: Laugh-out-loud sexy comedy with Brooklyn Decker and David Arquette. Navigating through the trials and tribulations of dating in the 21st century, a recently singleton's search for Mrs. Right leads him through some wild, crazy and hilarious experiences. But sometimes Mrs. Right is not even a click away.

programme.title: Anti-Life
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat sci-fi thriller with an (inter)stellar cast starring Bruce Willis (Die Hard), Cody Kearsley (Riverdale) and Thomas Jane (The Mist). Set in the near future, a spaceship with survivors flees a devastating plague on planet Earth. But the ship has a stowaway: a shape-shifting alien whose goal is to kill. Clay and his team of mechanics are picked to maintain the interstellar ark.

programme.title: Anti-Life
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat sci-fi thriller with an (inter)stellar cast starring Bruce Willis (Die Hard), Cody Kearsley (Riverdale) and Thomas Jane (The Mist). Set in the near future, a spaceship with survivors flees a devastating plague on planet Earth. But the ship has a stowaway: a shape-shifting alien whose goal is to kill. Clay and his team of mechanics are picked to maintain the interstellar ark.

programme.title: Discarnate
programme.desc: The producer of Independence Day: Resurgence brings you this spine-tingling descent into the supernatural. A grieving neuro-scientist creates a mind-altering serum that reconnects people to the other side. However it unknowingly attracts a more sinister being. This mind-bending horror stars Thomas Kretschmann (King Kong) Josh Stewart (Interstellar) and Bex Taylor-Klaus (TVs Scream).

programme.title: Feedback
programme.desc: Starring Eddie Marsan (This is England), Paul Anderson (Peaky Blinders) and Ivana Baquero (Pans Labyrinth) and from the creators of Rec. Black Mirror meets Die Hard. Jarvis is a star journalist of a successful London late night radio show. One evening, two armed men burst in and take control. Their mission: to shed light on a scandal that could spell the end of Jarvis' established career.

programme.title: Initiation
programme.desc: Carefree partying turns sinister in this edgy slasher that sees Whiton University unravel on the night a star-athlete is murdered in the wake of a buried assault allegation. As a masked killer targets students, a trio of sorority sisters race to uncover the schools dark secrets. Starring Yancy Butler (Kick-Ass), Lochlyn Munro (Riverdale) and Jon Huertas (This Is Us).

programme.title: 13 Minutes
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat disaster thriller featuring an incredible cast, including Amy Smart (The Butterfly Effect), Thora Birch (American Beauty), Peter Facinelli (Twilight franchise) and Anne Heche (Volcano) and boasting jaw-dropping visual effects from the team behind Everest. The largest tornado on record threatens to ravage a small town, leaving residents with only 13 minutes to find shelter.

programme.title: Bigger
programme.desc: A rags-to-riches biopic of visionary Joe Weider, set in the world of fitness and starring Tyler Hoechlin (Supergirl), Julianne Hough (Dirty Grandpa), Aneurin Barnard (Dunkirk) and Kevin Durand (Wolverine). Brothers Joe & Ben Weider were the architects of muscle. Along the way they discovered Arnold Schwarzenegger, inspired female empowerment, championed diversity and started a worldwide movement.

programme.title: Kindling
programme.desc: Inspired by true events. In this fresh coming-of-age tale, Sid, a young adult, wants to create a legacy and be remembered forever as he faces mortality due to a terminal illness. With his obsession for astronomy and the atmosphere, he comes up with a plan to bring all his friends together and make this summer unforgettable.

programme.title: Come Away
programme.desc: The film follows the adventures of siblings Alice and Peter who transform into Peter Pan and Alice in Wonderland in a bid to help their parents - played by Oyelowo and Jolie - overcome the tragedy of losing their eldest son. Peter and Alice find strength in the power of their imaginations and set off on a real adventure to try and rescue the family - escaping to a destiny of eternal boyhood in the distant isle of Neverland - whilst Alice delves into a world of Wonderland.

programme.title: The Bombing
programme.desc: Inspired by the heroic, untold true story of Chongqing. Starring legends Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Adrien Brody (The Pianist), this pulse-pounding war epic centres around the courage of Chinas citizens during WWII. As U.S. Air Force commander Jack Johnson trains the Chinese aviators to battle Japanese fighters, a hot-headed pilot begs to fly a powerful bomber that could stop the attacks.

programme.title: Valhalla: Legend of Thor
programme.desc: No man, woman or child may defy the gods. When Thor and Loki seek refuge in the home of mortals, the youngest son fails to heed a warning from the gods. As atonement for the family's sins, the gods take the two youngest children under their wing and embark on an epic adventure from Midgard to Valhalla that will see them stare down ruthless giants, barbaric gods and the dreaded wolf Fenrir.

programme.title: Wolves of War
programme.desc: A fast-paced, action-packed war thriller based on true events. Decorated British officer Jack Wallace (Ed Westwick - Gossip Girl) must lead a band of Allied commandos across enemy lines to rescue an American scientist held hostage by the Nazis. With information that could turn the tide of war, these unlikely heroes must traverse enemy territory with an untrained US civilian to secure victory.

programme.title: Nine Bullets
programme.desc: Gypsy Moon is a novelist by day and when night falls, she dances to earn her keep .However, when the family next door to her is brutally attacked and murdered by crime boss Jack and his thugs. Gypsy finds herself the protector to a young boy and his dog the only survivors of the attack. Gypsy quickly realises she is the only thing that stands between them and their survival.

programme.title: Repression
programme.desc: A gripping and twisty Hitchcock-esque thriller set in Scotland with a stellar British cast, including Peter Mullan and Rebecca Front. When therapist Marianne attempts a new life, she is thrown off course by her young patient Manny who claims he can control her future. Marianne struggles with silence from her colleagues and her own mind as she tries to uncover the truth behind Mannys drawings.

programme.title: The Final Wish
programme.desc: Following the death of his father, Aaron returns to his hometown to help his devastated mother pack up his father's belongings. Discovering one item of unknown origin, Aaron soon comes to believe his wishes are coming true but the more wishes he makes the more danger he puts those closest to him in.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A self-appointed angel of death on a mission beyond the law. A sniper who targets abortion doctors and then disappears into the shadowy underground that supports and protects him. But when the sniper’s mission moves to murder, a city is thrown into blind panic that spreads across the country and beyond. Armed with the very latest in forensic technology, this is one game the cops have no intention of losing.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Glamorous Las Vegas, Nevada is famous for wealth, lady luck and second chances. A murder mystery where nothing is as it seems and anyone is capable of anything, only forensic science can expose the truth and catch the killer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)

Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are in Honolulu (hoping for two weeks of sun, surf and no assignments) when they receive a call from Charlie advising that Congressman Knight's son, David, honeymooning with his wife, Marti, has been attacked while moonlight picnicking on the beach. David is critically injured and Marti is missing. The Angels pass all the tests -- sign on as lifeguards. Marti has been kidnapped and terrorized by three toughs who hold her in a secluded beach house. The three men later ram the legs of Kris' lifeguard stand with their vehicle but Kelly and Julie arrive in time to save her as the toughs escape. Bosley finds that there have been other complaints of beach assaults and the Angels recognize, from the pictures, the three who tried to attack Kris. Ted, one of the men, unbeknownst to the other two, takes Marti out of the beach house and drives to a phone where he calls Bosley with a ransom offer. Meanwhile, Marti gets away and into a shopping center where she is spotted wandering in a daze and is rescued by the Angels. The other two men discover what Ted has done and kill him. Later, Kris and Kelly are picked up and taken by the two toughs to the beach house. Kelly gets to her radio (while the two have Kris in another room) and reaches Bosley and Julie who come to the rescue and apprehend the kidnappers. David and Marti are well on their way to full recovery.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Steve Moss, owner of the Tropicana nightclub in Honolulu, is kidnapped, after firing young dancer, Donna Lindsey. He is taken in a van to a warehouse, where he is put into a cage with 60's rock music blaring in his ears. One of the specialties of his club is dancers in cages performing to 60's rock music. Steve is known as a hard taskmaster and is disliked by his dancers, particularly head dance show director, Stacy Parrish. A ransom note appears asking for $1 million with a note saying there will be one dancer missing each day until it is paid. Much to the surprise of everyone, Marian Moss, Steve's wife, advises that she doesn't have the $1 million asked. Since the Tropicana has been a lucrative nightclub, the Angels and Bosley (in various disguises) investigate and find through Donna Lindsey that Moss was really helping the young girls who couldn't make it in show business, and that is where the money went. They also discover that Stacy was a girlfriend of Moss before he met Marian and Stacy has staged the whole thing. They locate the warehouse where Moss is being kept and where Julie has also been taken. The two are freed and Stacy is taken into custody.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families. Kris gets a job with the Catlins as a still master. Kelly gets a job with the Bartletts as a driver. Julie takes a job as a waitress at Joe's Diner. Bosley poses as a wealthy southerner trying to buy both families out. The Angels find that the shootings and hijackings have not been done by the families, but by a group headed by Max Lacy from New York. Lacy is trying to corner the whiskey market and gain political control of the state. The Angels are able to stop a gunfight between the family elders, Hawkshaw Bartlett and Bluford Catlin, and show them who the real culprits are. Max Lacy and his group are arrested. Hobby Dan and Melinda are happily reunited.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture. The Angels track Thornwood to an apartment complex. Kris, posing as a confidence artist, rents the apartment next to his. Bosley poses as a Texan from whom she has swindled $50,000. Kris and Thornwood become friends, and he confesses to her that he has another scheme going. Kelly and Julie follow Thornwood to a museum owned by plain-looking Monica Thackery. Thornwood is posing as Professor Thornwood and has asked the smitten Monica to marry him and deposit $150,000 to an account supposedly for importing some pieces of art. Charlie, Bosley and the Angels find that Monica is the daughter of an eastern syndicate head, Joe Fenell. Thornwood is planning a phony marriage ceremony with Monica and then to withdraw the money and run. The Angels trick Thornwood into a real marriage with Monica because she is so much in love with him. They figure that her father will keep Thornwood in line. Thornwood, finding that he has been tricked, tries to escape, but is caught by Joe Fenell and his henchmen. Fenell warns him to be good to Monica or else. Thornwood knows that he has to stick with Monica and be a good husband...or else.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business. Kris takes a job as a waitress across the street from the cab garage. Julie becomes a driver and Kelly, a dispatcher. Two employees, Jake Barnett, ex-con, and Sarge, a shell-shocked hallucinating casualty of World War II, are both under suspicion. It seems Tom Archer had fired Sarge and advised him to go to the V.A. hospital for treatment. Later, Julie's cab catches fire and she and her passenger escape just in time. Jake advises Julie that Sarge's ex-wife was killed by a cab and he is starting the fires to put Tom and Laurie's cab company out of business. The Angels go to Sarge's room, but he escapes through a window, goes up on the roof, and tries to jump to the next building. He misses and is killed. The Angels then find out that Sarge's wife was not killed by a cab. Instead, the woman who Jake lived with was the victim of the accident. Julie takes Jake out in her cab with a tape recorder on -- the others listening -- and gets Jake to admit that he is really the guilty one. He takes off in the cab -- Kris arrives and she and Julie pursue him and trap him at the Los Angeles River. The other Angels praise Julie for her driving expertise and she admits she learned it from an old boyfriend in her neighborhood who drove stolen cars.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Earth from above - 1 - The sea needs us as we need the sea - Part 2
programme.sub-title: The sea needs us as we need the sea - Part 2
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 protected by a coral reef.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - David Jeannerot
programme.desc: David Jeannerot left the world of fashion and abandoned his career as artistic director to become a plant. An exceptional florist who wishes to give back all its place to nature in the city. - David had a dream life. He traveled around the world for major ready-to-wear brands. But under the appearance David was actually very isolated. To give meaning to his life, and to go in the direction of his personal convictions, he decides to become a plantist. He arranges corners of greenery on the smallest window sill with the aim of bringing nature to the city, and to make Paris greener.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Agostina (Argentina)
programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. She found it almost impossible to find the right materials, so she decided to make her own. Research led her to bamboo fibers and she realised she could make a positive impact on the environment, while developing sustainable and ethical fashion.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Solenn (Nantes)
programme.desc: A former school teacher reinvents herself when she discovers a passion for sharing other women’s stories. Always inspired by the journeys of strong women, Solenn began a blog to celebrate the women in her community. - Solenn’s energy and passion fueled a dream of starting her own magazine. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Sophie (Nantes)
programme.desc: Always an artist at heart, Sophie grew up in the countryside amongst nature and farm animals. Her love for creating art while respecting nature turned into a drive to seek out sustainable vegetable dyes. - Today, her artwork and craft are intertwined as she makes beautiful prints and motifs that she colours with natural dyes, prepared from handpicked variety of flowers and plants that turn into stunning creations.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - The Bordeaux country
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - Poultry on the menu
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew. Julie will then head back up towards the center to discover an amazing fly maker who uses rooster feathers!

programme.sub-title: The Earth does not belong to Man, Man belongs to the Earth - Part 1
programme.desc: We end up at Yellowstone National Park in the United States, it is located in the first natural park created in the world. In Peru, the Amazon rainforest is suffering from massive deforestation. The desert on Beijing's doorstep is regularly hit by sandstorms. Some experts predict that the Chinese capital could be threatened by deserts within a hundred years. In Montana, American agricultural productivity has an ecological and human cost. Engineer Marc Dufumier explains how mechanisation is undermining the natural balance. In Brazil, agrofuels have made it possible to reduce dependence on oil, cut urban air pollution and even limit greenhouse gas emissions. In Los Angeles, human activities have disrupted the greenhouse effect and exacerbated it. Today, the Earth is heating up.

Aspired by success, money, success, he will create several clinics and will eventually lose the human aspects and lose himself. A new turn, a new meeting and Paul will finally resume his dreams of painting. Follow Paul in his tumults and his happiness found.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Annabelle Higgins and Valérie Sirois
programme.desc: They are beautiful sisters, they are passionate about nature and they have a very strong common point: entrepreneurship. After years of evolution in consumer sectors, discover Annabelle and Valérie who knew how to listen to their passion to create a fitness and surf club (for Annabelle) and a zero waste grocery store (for Valérie).

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Véronick Desmarais
programme.desc: The everyday work is not always easy and it is sometimes difficult to get by. If there is one thing that Véronick has learned from her experience and those around her, it is because she is able to surpass that and to embark on her dreams and plans to become a massage therapist. You will believe in your abilities too.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Violaine Courtois
programme.desc: Everything started from the dream of her parents, she becomes a veterinarian. In her career that she launched backwards, Violaine will meet people who will take her to a different path of life. The chance will be at the rendezvous but it is especially the courage to resume studies and create his company that will build his project. Follow the encounters and travels of Violaine that brought her to fasciatherapy and nonviolent communication.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Leah
programme.desc: Working 12 hours a day in the tech industry, Leah was living a fast paced high-life that only looked good on paper. Frequently ill and constantly exhausted, she experienced a burn out and decided to tackle meditation. What came next was a radical change in lifestyle that resulted in a move to Bali, The Island of the Gods. Today she sees her career blossom as she enjoys sharing her meditation knowledge with the world.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - winter vegetables
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits. Finally, we will conclude as usual with a recipe from a chef, who will go out of his way to create a seasonal recipe for us.

programme.sub-title: The Earth does not belong to Man, Man belongs to the Earth - Part 2

In Utah, Salt Lake City is a good example of how we live today: there are 37 cities in the world with more than 8 million inhabitants. programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Andrew
programme.desc: For many years, Andrew was a successful American child-actor on the popular show My Wife and Kids, until he dropped everything and embarked on a journey to find life’s true meaning. He now lives in Bali where he coaches people from all over the world on how to radically transform their diets. His 360° transformative journey includes meditation, yoga and nutrition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. - Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. - Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!
